name: svg-french-press-command-a-plus-s2-r4
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="no"?>
<svg width="800" height="600" viewBox="0 0 800 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <style>
    .component { fill: #f8f8f8; stroke: #333; stroke-width: 2; }
    .metal { fill: #e0e0e0; stroke: #666; stroke-width: 2; }
    .handle { fill: #8B4513; stroke: #5a3a1a; stroke-width: 2; }
    .filter { fill: #d9ead3; stroke: #666; stroke-width: 1.5; }
    .mesh { fill: #e8f4e8; stroke: #666; stroke-width: 1.5; }
    .gasket { fill: #ffd700; stroke: #666; stroke-width: 1; }
    .text { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #333; font-weight: bold; }
    .exploded-line { stroke: #666; stroke-dasharray: 5,5; stroke-width: 1; }
    .assembly-line { stroke: #333; stroke-width: 1; stroke-opacity: 0.6; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" fill="#fafafa"/>

  <!-- Main cylinder body (exploded, front removed to show internals) -->
  <!-- Back half of body -->
  <path d="M150,100
            L645,100
            L645,445
            L150,445
            Z" class="component" fill-opacity="0.9"/>
  <!-- Side walls -->
  <path d="M150,95 L645,95 L645,450 L150,450 Z" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,4" opacity="0.9"/>
  
  <!-- Glass simulation lines on back wall -->
  <g stroke="#999" stroke-width="0.5" stroke-dasharray="3,3">
    <line x1="155" y1="105" x2="640" y2="105"/>
    <line x1="155" y1="440" x2="640" y2="440"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Lid (exploded up) -->
  <g transform="translate(400, 50)">
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="60" class="metal"/>
    <rect x="-40" y="-20" width="80" height="30" class="handle"/>
    <rect x="-30" y="-10" width="60" height="10" fill="#A0522D"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Plunger rod (exploded down, with cross-handle) -->
  <g transform="translate(400, 450)">
    <rect x="-5" y="-10" width="10" height="190" class="metal"/>
    <rect x="-37.5" y="-7.5" width="75" height="15" class="handle"/>
    <rect x="-27.5" y="-2.5" width="55" height="5" fill="#A0522D"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Filter assembly (exploded down, separated pieces) -->
  <g transform="translate(400, 320)">
    <!-- Bottom filter plate -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="55" class="filter"/>
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="50" stroke="#666" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
    <text x="0" y="-58" text-anchor="middle" class="text">Filter Plate</text>
  </g>

  <g transform="translate(400, 280)">
    <!-- Middle mesh plate -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="45" class="mesh"/>
    <g stroke="#666" stroke-width="1.5">
      <line x1="-45" y1="0" x2="45" y2="0"/>
      <line x1="0" y1="-45" x2="0" y2="45"/>
      <line x1="-35" y1="-35" x2="35" y2="-35"/>
      <line x1="-35" y1="35" x2="35" y2="35"/>
    </g>
    <text x="0" y="-48" text-anchor="middle" class="text">Mesh Plate</text>
  </g>

  <g transform="translate(400, 340)">
    <!-- Top gasket/plate -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="40" fill="#ffe4c4" stroke="#666" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- Gasket material visualization -->
    <path d="M0,-20
              C0,-35 15,-45 30,-45
              C45,-45 60,-35 60,-20
              C60,-5 45,10 30,10
              C15,10 0,-5 0,-20 Z" fill="#ffd700" opacity="0.9"/>
    <text x="0" y="-42" text-anchor="middle" class="text">Gasket</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Cross-piece handle for plunger -->
  <g transform="translate(400, 410)">
    <rect x="-37.5" y="-7.5" width="75" height="15" class="handle"/>
    <rect x="-27.5" y="-2.5" width="55" height="5" fill="#A0522D"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Exploded positioning visualization -->
  <g stroke="#666" stroke-dasharray="6,4" stroke-width="1">
    <!-- Body outline (dashed to show cavity) -->
    <rect x="150" y="100" width="500" height="345" fill="none" stroke="#ccc" stroke-dasharray="4,4" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- Assembly lines showing relationships -->
    <line x1="400" y1="120" x2="400" y2="55"/>
    <line x1="400" y1="395" x2="400" y2="325"/>
    <line x1="400" y1="315" x2="400" y2="275"/>
    <line x1="400" y1="270" x2="400" y2="235"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Labels -->
  <text x="400" y="85" text-anchor="middle" class="text">Lid</text>
  <text x="400" y="460" text-anchor="middle" class="text">Plunger Rod</text>
  <text x="400" y="355" text-anchor="middle" class="text">Filter Plate</text>
  <text x="400" y="315" text-anchor="middle" class="text">Mesh Plate</text>
  <text x="400" y="275" text-anchor="middle" class="text">Gasket</text>
  
  <!-- Assembly direction arrows -->
  <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none">
    <path d="M400,130 L395,125 L405,125 Z"/>
    <path d="M400,395 L395,400 L405,400 Z"/>
  </g>
</svg>
